name: smooth on the fine grid, correct from coarser grids
mechanism: a few relaxation sweeps on the fine grid remove the rapidly varying error; the remaining residual is transferred to a coarser grid where the slowly varying error is cheap to solve (recursively), the coarse correction is interpolated back and added, and a final smoothing sweep cleans the interpolation

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Multigrid methods (MG methods), a group of algorithms for solving differential equations using a hierarchy of discretiza' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Differential equation solving:

requires: a hierarchy of grids with transfer operators
a smoother that kills high-frequency error
fails_when: anisotropic or non-elliptic operators defeat the smoother/coarse split
